rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root of the spec of the hinge laws with the burner-heating law with the fuel table, not a candidate: the law tensors of the root of acme_normal.wsp8, copied by tools/wsp/fuel_member_edits.py, which chooses nothing, and the neutral fuel table (ethane, propane and butane on their own vertices with the molar masses the indicators chose, the other rows not admitted, no shift, no bound). No number was taken from the PSI-159 tables and none was estimated. Data-informed candidates of acme_normal-wsp-v11 are literal revisions of this release, so that the registry records them as revisions with development exposure.
